name: boss-6
about: Boss Rush: Inflation Titan, second version (2026-11-16): a headless steam-boiler titan whose 'head' is a brass valve handwheel on a short pipe, a pressure gauge in its chest with the needle in the red, two smokestacks, piston arms. The first version (boss-6-v1.json) had a small domed head with two round lights that read as a diving helmet with portholes. Tripo H3.1 from concept boss06b-titan-sd-0; rigged by Tripo (rig v1.0, biped); eight clips retargeted from Tripo's presets (two requests); parts from Tripo segmentation, each bound whole to the bone that owns it.
